core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aflatoon is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Loyal and devoted servant”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aflatoon corresponds to the Arabic form أفلاطون (ف ل ط ن). Its core sense is loyal and devoted servant. Aflāṭūn is the Arabic form of the Greek name Plato (Πλάτων). The source record's gloss 'Loyal and devoted servant' is unsupported.

arabic.name: أفلاطون
arabic.long_meaning: Aflatoon (أفلاطون) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي عبد مخلص، خادم وفيّ. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
